+name: CI/CD
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+  pull_request:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+jobs:
+  lint:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 24
+          cache: "npm"
+      - run: npm ci
+      - run: npm run lint
+
+  typecheck:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 24
+          cache: "npm"
+      - run: npm ci
+      - run: npm run typecheck
+
+  codeql:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      security-events: write
+      actions: read
+      contents: read
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Initialize CodeQL
+        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4
+        with:
+          languages: javascript-typescript
+
+      - name: Perform Analysis
+        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4
+
+  build:
+    needs: [lint, typecheck]
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+    env:
+      PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY: ${{ secrets.PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Set up Node.js version
+        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 24
+          cache: "npm"
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+
+      - name: Build
+        run: npm run astro:build
+
+      - name: Prune dev dependencies
+        run: npm prune --production
+
+      - name: Upload Artifact
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: still-they-shine
+          path: .
+
+  deploy:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    needs: [build, codeql]
+    permissions:
+      id-token: write
+      contents: read
+
+    if: github.event_name == 'push' &&
+      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
+      !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip deploy]')
+    steps:
+      - name: Download artifact from build job
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: still-they-shine
+
+      - name: Login to Azure
+        uses: azure/login@v2
+        with:
+          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZUREAPPSERVICE_CLIENTID_C50EC97922514FB3BFA46F8BDAF921EE }}
+          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZUREAPPSERVICE_TENANTID_A42443BFCF674F979051E82B31CD33C6 }}
+          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZUREAPPSERVICE_SUBSCRIPTIONID_2503868858414E02BF2D60C0333A84C5 }}
+
+      - name: "Deploy to Azure"
+        id: deploy-to-azure
+        uses: azure/webapps-deploy@v3
+        with:
+          app-name: "still-they-shine"
+          slot-name: "Production"
+          package: .
+          startup-command: "node ./dist/server/entry.mjs"

+name: CI/CD
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+  pull_request:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+jobs:
+  lint:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 24
+          cache: "npm"
+      - run: npm ci
+      - run: npm run lint
+
+  typecheck:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 24
+          cache: "npm"
+      - run: npm ci
+      - run: npm run typecheck
+
+  codeql:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      security-events: write
+      actions: read
+      contents: read
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Initialize CodeQL
+        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
+        with:
+          languages: javascript-typescript
+
+      - name: Perform Analysis
+        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
+
+  build:
+    needs: [lint, typecheck]
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+    env:
+      PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY: ${{ secrets.PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Set up Node.js version
+        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 24
+          cache: "npm"
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+
+      - name: Build
+        run: npm run astro:build
+
+      - name: Prune dev dependencies
+        run: npm prune --production
+
+      - name: Upload Artifact
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: still-they-shine
+          path: .
+
+  deploy:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    needs: [build, codeql]
+    permissions:
+      id-token: write
+      contents: read
+
+    if: github.event_name == 'push' &&
+      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
+      !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip deploy]')
+    steps:
+      - name: Download artifact from build job
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: still-they-shine
+
+      - name: Login to Azure
+        uses: azure/login@v2
+        with:
+          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZUREAPPSERVICE_CLIENTID_C50EC97922514FB3BFA46F8BDAF921EE }}
+          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZUREAPPSERVICE_TENANTID_A42443BFCF674F979051E82B31CD33C6 }}
+          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZUREAPPSERVICE_SUBSCRIPTIONID_2503868858414E02BF2D60C0333A84C5 }}
+
+      - name: "Deploy to Azure"
+        id: deploy-to-azure
+        uses: azure/webapps-deploy@v3
+        with:
+          app-name: "still-they-shine"
+          slot-name: "Production"
+          package: .
+          startup-command: "node ./dist/server/entry.mjs"
